simple.summary: מַגְפִּיעָשׁ (Magpîyʻâsh) means Magpiash , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Neh 10 21.

definitions.full: H4047. Magpiash מַגְמִּיעָשׁ proper name, masculine a chief of the people , Neh 10:21 , ᵐ5 Βαγαφης , A Μαιαφης , ᵐ5 L Μεγαιας .
